```lean
theorem lg_target (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) : a / b + b / c + c / a ≥ 3 := by
  let a_b := a / b
  let b_c := b / c
  let c_a := c / a
  have h1 : a_b ≥ 1 := by apply Real.ge_one_of_pos; exact (ha.trans (Real.inv_pos (hb.trans hc)))
  have h2 : b_c ≥ 1 := by apply Real.ge_one_of_pos; exact (hb.trans (Real.inv_pos (hc.trans ha)))
  have h3 : c_a ≥ 1 := by apply Real.ge_one_of_pos; exact (hc.trans (Real.inv_pos (ha.trans hb)))
  apply Real.ge_three_of_ge_one_and_ge_one_and_ge_one
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
```
